profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dassault Systèmes Biovia
profile.summary: I am a major technology wiz and love to do anything that involves it. I love to play video games and solve puzzles. I was born into the beginning of computers and started to use them at a young age. I first started off watching my parents use them for their work and soon learned to use them for my schooling. I love the freedom that comes with having a virtual environment to work with and being able to use any technology as a tool to help me with daily tasks. I started off in the HTML, JavaScript, CSS world and slowly moved out from there. I am now a graduate of George Fox University with a degree in Computer Software Engineering and have a background in everything from databases, mobile development, networking, system administration, software engineering, and many more. My dream is to one day live in a world where we as a human race go back to our roots of discovery and use technology as a tool and a guide to help us along the way.

projects.title: Haptic Feedback
projects.description: We were tasked with designing and building a prototype device that would monitor a person swaying and give them haptic feedback if they were about to fall over in order to stabilize them.
